metrics.description: Measures how effectively the code cleans data coming from external sources, identifying locations where user input is used directly in sensitive operations without being checked for malicious content.
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Sanitization Coverage % = (Sanitized Entry Points / Total External Entry Points) × 100
metrics.expected_threshold: 100% of external entry points have input sanitization

metrics.description: Tracks the movement of sensitive data through the application, ensuring private data is encrypted or masked and never leaks into logs or insecure output streams.
metrics.derivation:
Sensitive Exposure Count =
count(Semgrep secret-related results)
metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Data Leak Score = Count(Sensitive Data Paths reaching insecure output) × 30
metrics.expected_threshold: 0 sensitive data paths reaching logs or unencrypted output

metrics.raw_measurement_formula: Regulatory Score = (Controls Passing Scan / Total Required Controls) × 100
